zh: 把所有子段按“谁是最大值”来分组：每个子段的漏洞值是长度乘最大值，所以可以对每个元素计算它作为最大值的那些子段的长度总和。
用单调栈求每个位置向左、向右能扩展多远：左边找严格大于它的位置，右边找大于等于它的位置，这样相同最大值只归属其中一个位置，不会重复计数。
设位置 i 向左可选起点数为 L、向右可选终点数为 R，则这些子段长度之和为 L·R·(L+R)/2；把 a[i] 乘上这个值累加。L·R·(L+R)/2 在 64 位内，但乘上 a[i] 前要先取模，最后对 10^9+7 取模输出。
en: Group all segments by which element is their maximum: a segment's value is its length times its maximum, so for each element sum the lengths of the segments where it is the maximum.

Use a monotonic stack to find how far each position extends: on the left stop at a strictly greater element, on the right at a greater-or-equal one, so a repeated maximum belongs to exactly one position and nothing is counted twice.

If position i has L possible starts on the left and R possible ends on the right, those segments have total length L*R*(L+R)/2; add a[i] times this value. L*R*(L+R)/2 fits in 64 bits, but reduce it modulo 10^9+7 before multiplying by a[i], and print the sum modulo 10^9+7.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Use monotonic stacks to give every maximum its left and right boundaries. On the left look for a strictly greater element and on the right for a greater-or-equal one, so a repeated maximum belongs to only one position.

## Proof of correctness

Let the numbers of possible extensions to the left and right be L and R. All segments containing this position and owned by it have total length Σ(a + b - 1) = LR(L + R)/2. Multiplying by the element and summing counts every contiguous segment exactly once.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
